question: One of the following types of transport through membranes does NOT exist:

options.opa: Ion transport facilitated by ionophore (against electrochemical gradient).
options.opb: Facilitated diffusion (in favor of electrochemical gradient)
options.opd: Ionic channel (in favor of electrochemical gradient).
options.ope: Simple diffusion (in favor of concentration gradient).

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Ion transport facilitated by ionophore (against electrochemical gradient) -> Unclear existence -> 70% CHAIN: Facilitated diffusion (in favor of electrochemical gradient) -> Exists -> 100% CHAIN: Primary active transport (against electrochemical gradient) -> Exists -> 100% CHAIN: Ionic channel (in favor of electrochemical gradient) -> Exists -> 100% CHAIN: Simple diffusion (in favor of concentration gradient) -> Exists -> 70%
